name: Roman Road
tagline: A typing tutor that tracks your slowest words and letter pairs and drills them.

awards: Happy Hacking Keyboard: Type Beyond - Rethinking Interaction Through the Keyboard

problem: Popular typing tests use easy word lists that inflate speed and do not build real-world skill, the team says.
solution: Measures per-word errors and bigram latency across diagnostics and system-wide free writing, generates targeted drills and shows progress graphs, with AI feedback on written diagnostics.
demo_moment: Team-described: take a diagnostic, then a drill built from your weakest bigrams.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Happy Hacking Keyboard: Type Beyond - Rethinking Interaction Through the Keyboard” among 307 submissions.

lessons: Win a hardware sponsor's prize by making their device the centre of the experience.
